tools.name: workinsiders_search_tools
tools.description: Searches the Work Insiders directory of 1,350+ recruiting, HR, sales prospecting and AI tools by free text and filters: category, first party MCP server, API, free plan, free trial, AI-native and maximum starting price. Returns up to 25 tools per page, each with its starting price, flags and Work Insiders page link. Full detail on one tool comes from workinsiders_get_tool.

query.description: Free text such as a tool name or a job to be done ("LinkedIn outreach", "AI interview notes"). Optional.

category.description: Category slug or name, for example "ats", "sourcing" or "Email finders". The full list comes from workinsiders_list_categories.

has_mcp.description: Only tools whose vendor runs its own (first party) MCP server.

has_api.description: Only tools with a public API.

free_plan.description: Only tools with a free plan or free tier.

free_trial.description: Only tools with a confirmed free trial.

ai_native.description: Only tools that ship real AI features.

max_monthly_price.description: Maximum starting price in USD per month. Tools with a free plan count as $0. Per seat prices count one seat, yearly prices are divided by 12, and quote-only or pay-per-use tools are left out.

sort.description: Sort order. Default relevance (editor picks first when there is no query).

offset.description: Number of results to skip. next_offset in a response is the start of the next page.

tools.name: workinsiders_get_tool
tools.description: Returns the full Work Insiders profile of one named tool: what it does, pricing with plans and the date the price was checked, free trial, first party MCP server and API, AI features, bottom line, strengths, watch-outs, best for, pros and cons, integrations, Capterra rating and named alternatives. Finding tools by need or filter is what workinsiders_search_tools does.

tool.description: Tool name, slug or Work Insiders URL, for example "Greenhouse" or "greenhouse".

tools.name: workinsiders_compare_tools
tools.description: Side by side comparison of 2 to 4 named tools: starting price, free plan and trial, MCP, API, AI-native, best for, watch-outs, bottom line and Capterra rating.

tools.name: workinsiders_find_alternatives
tools.description: Alternatives to one named tool: first the ones Work Insiders names in its write-up (with the reason), then others from the same category. Filterable by MCP, free plan and price.

has_mcp.description: Only alternatives with a first party MCP server.

free_plan.description: Only alternatives with a free plan or free tier.

max_monthly_price.description: Maximum starting price in USD per month. Tools with a free plan count as $0. Per seat prices count one seat, yearly prices are divided by 12, and quote-only or pay-per-use tools are left out.

tools.name: workinsiders_list_categories
tools.description: Lists every Work Insiders category (ATS, sourcing, email finders, AI interviewing, payroll and so on) with its slug, tool count and page link.

tools.name: workinsiders_category_overview
tools.description: What a category costs and who leads it: tool count, median public starting price, how many hide their price or have a free plan, how many run an MCP server, editor picks, cheapest public prices and the category intro.

category.description: Category slug or name, for example "ats", "sourcing" or "Email finders". The full list comes from workinsiders_list_categories.

tools.name: workinsiders_ats_integrations
tools.description: Which tools integrate with an applicant tracking system (Bullhorn, Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, JobAdder and others), from the Work Insiders ATS compatibility data. With a tool given as well, it checks that one pair. Each match says whether the vendor confirms it, the evidence link and the sync direction.

ats.description: ATS name or slug, for example "Bullhorn".

tool.description: Optional tool name or slug, to check a single tool against the ATS.

category.description: Category slug or name, for example "ats", "sourcing" or "Email finders". The full list comes from workinsiders_list_categories.

confirmed_only.description: Only integrations the vendor itself confirms.

offset.description: Number of results to skip. next_offset in a response is the start of the next page.

tools.name: workinsiders_funded_startups
tools.description: Startups that announced a funding round or filed an SEC Form D in the last 90 days, from the Work Insiders "Just raised" list: amount, round, date, industry, country, investors, executives named in filings, open roles counted daily on the company's own job board, the change since the raise, sample job titles, hiring signals and a 0-100 recruiter fit score. Filterable by industry, stage, country, recency and hiring. A round that fits none of the listed industries is labelled "Other". Fields the source did not state are left out.

query.description: Free text matched against company name, description, job titles and investors. Optional.

country.description: Headquarters country, for example "United States", or "europe".

days.description: Rounds announced in the last N days.

hiring_only.description: Only companies with open roles on a public job board now.
